A '''holo-series''' was a form of [[holograph]]ic entertainment program. [[Who Are You To Accuse Me?]] was a popular holo-series produced by [[Millennium Holos]].<ref name="HSCSS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[Millennium Entertainments]] published the holo-series ''[[Revella's Journey: A Story of a Girl and Her Droid]]''.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
